runs.input: Tell me about the Forte's milk system
runs.task: Describe the LatteCore milk system of Belevico Forte (built-in, automatic rinse, makes cappuccino, latte and flat white).
runs.answer:
The Belevico Forte has the LatteCore milk system, which is built in and rinses itself automatically after each milk drink. It supports cappuccino, latte and flat white.
